title: Golf platoon joins an Army exercise

paragraphs.text: From 3–5 November, 1st Platoon (reinforced), Golf Company, under 2ndLt W. W. Jeffery, acted as the opposing force in the Army’s Operation Tendertouch at Camp Pendleton. The exercise was conducted by the 3rd Brigade, 5th Infantry Division (Mechanized), from Fort Carson, Colorado.

sections.heading: Playing the opposing force
sections.text: The transcription names 1st Platoon (reinforced), Golf Company, as the aggressors. In an exercise, that means playing the opposing side so the participating troops can practice against it.

sections.heading: Who organized it?
sections.text: The entry attributes the exercise to the U.S. Army’s 3rd Brigade, 5th Infantry Division (Mechanized), from Fort Carson, Colorado. It places the exercise at Camp Pendleton.
